text: REJECT: `ShipAsync` returns `ship.MainMoved` as `Requeued` even when `ship.Unjudged` is also set, whereas the original set `requeued` only in the `else if` branch, so a result with both set now also marks the merged packages requeued and records `requeued` in turn.json; the method's remaining complexity also looks borderline, since I count about 15 increments in the visible code before the unseen lines.
